claims.statement: A meal entry stores a scaled, confirmed nutrient snapshot as a single enc.v1. JSON envelope, so re-logging never re-queries and later food changes cannot rewrite history.

The photo estimate is meal-service's only Gemini call (a plain fetch against the Generative Language API, no SDK), and its failures are named by owner: COULD_NOT_READ for photo/shape faults versus the model's own errors.
isEstimated is derived in the app's entry editor from the item's known nutrient-key set (a photo estimate seeds all 27 fields) — it is not a wire field and not a stored column.
The USDA integration is one HTTP boundary (usda.client.ts against FoodData Central) plus a pure mapping module; usda_search returns names and USDA ids only.
@life/nutrition exports exactly five modules (nutrients, food, scale, sum, format) and does no I/O — the same math serves service, BFF and UI.
food.unit is a text column with NOT NULL DEFAULT 'g', one of the additive schema changes boot-time sync applied.
The meal → todo bridge rides the transactional outbox and the BFF drain; its service-to-service URL (MEAL_TODOS_API_URL) has no code fallback.
